title: BenchmarkService
responsibility: Coordinates benchmark validation, execution and result rendering for the CLI.

inputs.name: BenchmarkService.execute.operation
inputs.description: Selects the action: 'validate' prints the preview from prepareBenchmark and returns without calling runBenchmark, 'results' reads and prints the persisted run named by target, and any other value, such as 'run', starts a benchmark run.

inputs.name: BenchmarkService.execute.target
inputs.description: For 'results' it is a persisted run ID passed unchanged to repository.read, and for 'validate' and every other operation it is a definition path passed unchanged to prepareBenchmark or runBenchmark. The value is not checked or normalized, and any error from those calls is caught and passed to fail().

inputs.name: BenchmarkService.execute.options
inputs.description: json selects JSON output instead of the text table for every operation except 'validate', which always prints JSON. seed is forwarded unchanged to runBenchmark when a run starts and is ignored for 'validate' and 'results'.

outputs.name: BenchmarkService.execute
outputs.description: Resolves after printing the 'validate' preview as JSON, or the run or persisted run with its comparison as JSON when options.json is set and as a text table otherwise. Only 'run' sets process.exitCode to 1, when run.completedAt is falsy or a trial status is not 'passed'.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Raised by fail() for any error thrown inside perform(), such as from prepareBenchmark, repository.read or runBenchmark; execute passes the message of an Error, or 'Benchmark operation failed.' when the thrown value is not an Error. A SIGINT or SIGTERM during a run aborts the signal passed to runBenchmark with the reason Error('Benchmark interrupted.').
